newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jiangsu Expressway offers 1.222 bln H-shrs.
newsitem.headline: Jiangsu Expressway offers 1.222 bln H-shrs.

text.p: Chinese toll road operator Jiangsu Expressway Co Ltd said on Tuesday it is issuing 1.222 billion new H-shares, or 25 percent of its enlarged share capital, at HK$3.11 each in a global flotation.
The issue price will represent a prospective price to earnings multiple of 46.9 times on a fully-diluted basis and 52.8 times on a weighted average basis.
H-shares are shares of mainland Chinese state-owned enterprises listed in Hong Kong.
Jiangsu Expressway's public offering of shares in Hong Kong will run from June 18 to June 23, and dealing in the company's shares will begin on June 27.
HSBC Investment Bank Asia Ltd is the global coordinator, sponsor and lead manager of the issue.

Of the total issue, 6.8 percent will be offered to the public in Hong Kong, 32 percent will be earmarked for strategic placement and an international placement portion will take up the remaining 61.2 percent.
